text.text_excerpt: This is one of my favorite places to foodie-geek out over. I cannot recommend it enough, whether you're a foodie, a meatie, a locavore, or just a person who eats food on a regular basis. One of the greatest things about Cleaver & Co. (and I mean this with no cheesiness intended) is the total passion these guys have for what they do. Want to learn more about a cut? Ask. They're dying to teach you. I've actually gotten smarter by shopping here. Don't know what you want? Need to impress a date? Just ask them for a suggestion, they can and will hook you up. I grew up on a farm and have missed real meat most of my adult life. But those days are gone! Suggestion: Try some of their prepared food...

I cannot gush enough about this local gem. I love the fact that the folks in this place are so helpful and more than willing to accommodate your wishes. I saw the fresh prepared sausages they offer, and I asked who I presume is the owner about some "Latin Chorizo Sausage" and they tried to open my eyes up to all kinds of other things I had never thought about. After it was all said and done i walked out with a beautiful rump roast cap and ideas on how to make a Brazilian Picanha in my apartment. Will be back. It's a little bit more expensive than what most folks may be used to but that's the price for someone to take all the guesswork out of making sure you get the freshest and most delic...

This place is great! The owner is very helpful and the hours are pretty good too. On the weekends they serve gumbo and cracklins. Both yummm. Would like to see them serve more, especially take out sandwiches. Try the duck confit.... Very excited to have a butcher in town and so close to our place!
